أستمني (form X)
# أَسْتَمْنِي (ʔastamnī) /ʔas.tam.niː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
# أَسْتَمْنِيَ (ʔastamniya) /ʔas.tam.ni.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
